description_en: Queries an Application Monitoring metric or a Browser Monitoring metric
description_zh: 分页查询应用监控或前端监控的相关监控指标
name: QueryMetricByPage

parameters.help_en: The time interval at which you want to query metric data. Unit: milliseconds. Minimum value: 60000
parameters.help_zh: 数据片的时间间隔，单位为毫秒，最小值为60000
parameters.name: interval_in_sec

parameters.help_en: The start of the time range to query. Unit: milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 起始时间的时间戳，精确到毫秒
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end of the time range to query. Unit: milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 结束时间的时间戳，精确到毫秒
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The dimension for arranging metrics in sequence. For more information, see the supplementary metrics
parameters.help_zh: 排序依据，可设为任一维度，请参见下文补充说明
parameters.name: order_by

parameters.help_en: The metric that you want to query. You cannot specify a custom metric. For more information, see the "Application monitoring metrics that can be queried" section
parameters.help_zh: 需要查询的指标，不可自定义输入，请参见下文补充说明
parameters.name: metric

parameters.help_en:
The order in which measures are sorted. Valid values:

`ASC`: ascending order
`DESC`: descending order

If you do not specify the parameter, data is not sorted
parameters.help_zh:
排序标准。取值：

`ASC`：升序。
`DESC`：降序。

不填则不排序
parameters.name: order

parameters.help_zh: 查询结果的页码，默认为`1`
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en: This parameter is no longer supported. The number of entries per page
parameters.help_zh: 此参数已不支持使用。查询结果的每页项目数量
parameters.name: page_size

fields.help_en: The key of the filter condition. You must set the key to `pid` or `regionId`
fields.help_zh: 筛选条件组合，必须添加`pid`和`regionId`条件
fields.name: key

fields.help_en: The value of the filter condition. You must set the value of the `pid` or `regionId` condition. For information about how to obtain the `pid`, see the "Obtain the PID of an application" section
fields.help_zh: 筛选条件组合，必须添加`pid`和`regionId`值，`pid`获取方式，请参见下文补充说明
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en: The dimensions of the metric that you want to query
parameters.name: dimensions

parameters.help_en: The measures of the metric that you want to query
parameters.name: measures

schema.description_en: The information about the array object

Code.description_en:
The HTTP status code returned for the request. Valid values:

2XX: The request was successful.
3XX: A redirection message was returned.
4XX: The request was invalid.
5XX: A server error occurred
Code.description_zh:
接口状态，取值说明如下：

2XX：成功。
3XX：重定向。
4XX：请求错误。
5XX：服务器错误

Data.description_en: The information about the array object

Completed.description_en:
Whether the paging query ends.

true: end.
false: Need to continue pagination (continue to query after CurrentPage+1)
Completed.description_zh:
分页查询是否结束。

true：结束。
false：需要继续分页（CurrentPage+1后继续查询）

items.description_zh: 返回数据的数据结构体列表

Page.description_en: The page number of the returned page

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries returned per page
PageSize.description_zh: 查询结果的每页项目数量

Total.description_en: The total number of entries returned
Total.description_zh:
查询结果的总项目数量。

此参数的返回值为估算值，仅用于分页结束判断，不代表实际的数据总量

Message.description_en: The error message returned if the call fails
Message.description_zh: 调用失败时返回的信息
Message.example: StartTime is mandatory for this action.

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful. Valid values:

`true`: The call was successful.
`false`: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
查询是否成功：

`true`：成功。
`false`：失败
